annotations.title: Ranking change: like for like or mix

description: Did rankings really fall? Average position in two windows split into like for like, re-weighting, new and lost pairs, with a noise band; pairs moved by more than 2; impressions and clicks to tell position, demand or click loss. Another organization's or an unconnected site answers not found. Read-only.

after_from.description: First day of the later window.

after_to.description: Last day of the later window (same length as the earlier one).

before_from.description: Instead of days: first day of the earlier window (give all four).

before_to.description: Last day of the earlier window.

by.description: Break each part down by query, page or device.

days.description: Window length in whole weeks of days (7, 14, … 182; default 28), ending on the latest day with data, against the same number of days before.

limit.description: How many of the biggest movers each way (default 5).

page.description: One page, exactly as webops_pages returns it.
